args.summary:
Updated `astropy/io/ascii/rst.py` so the RST writer supports `header_rows`, consistent with `FixedWidth`. Specifically:
- `RST.__init__` now accepts `header_rows` and forwards it to `FixedWidth.__init__`.
- `RST.write` no longer hardcodes `lines[1]` as the separator row; it uses `lines[len(self.data.header_rows)]`, so the RST border row is placed correctly for any number of header rows.
- `RST.__init__` also adjusts `data.start_line` based on the number of header rows so generated multi-header RST tables can be read back with the same `header_rows` option.

Verified with the PR reproduction case (QTable with wave/response units writing `format='ascii.rst'` with `header_rows=['name','unit']`), a default-output regression check, and a round-trip read. The full `astropy/io/ascii/tests` suite passes.
